sources.title: List of European cities by population within city limits - Wikipedia

output.findings:
Population figures for cities can vary significantly depending on whether they refer to the city proper (administrative boundaries) or the metropolitan area (urban agglomeration). Using official city-limit data as a consistent metric, London has a population of approximately 9.09 million, Berlin has approximately 3.69 million, and Paris has approximately 2.05 million.

When comparing these three specific cities, Berlin and Paris are the closest in size, though there remains a difference of over 1.6 million people between them. London is substantially larger than both, with a population more than double that of Berlin and more than four times that of Paris proper.

If metropolitan area data is used instead, the rankings and relative sizes change dramatically, as the Paris urban area is often cited as significantly larger (over 11 million) than the London metropolitan area (approximately 9.8 million), while Berlin's metropolitan population remains smaller than both at approximately 3.8 million.
